name: Recipes by Complexity
body:
Recipe Complexity 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6
Culinarian Recipes by 3rd Party Publishers

Note: Profiles include bitter (B), salty (S), sour (O), spicy (P), sweet (W), temperature (T), texture (X), and umami (U). Some recipes are learned by different stations at higher levels.
